name: HVVC 10U
tagline: Foundational skill development for young athletes.
cardText: Our developmental program introduces young athletes to competitive volleyball. Players learn fundamentals, build confidence, and develop a love for the game in a supportive, age-appropriate environment. Represent the club at all times, showing respect for yourself, your teammates, your coaches, and the organization.
overview: Foundational skill development, team systems, positioning, court awareness, confidence, and communication. This program is designed to introduce young athletes to volleyball in a supportive, growth-oriented environment.

seasonInfo.label: Practice
seasonInfo.value: Mondays & Wednesdays · 4:00–5:30 PM · Beatrice Cannady Elementary

highlights.title: Foundational Skills
highlights.text: Passing, setting, serving, and hitting fundamentals taught through age-appropriate drills and games.

highlights.title: Team Systems
highlights.text: Introduction to basic rotations, positioning, and team play concepts to build court awareness.

highlights.title: Confidence & Communication
highlights.text: Building self-confidence, learning to communicate on the court, and developing a positive competitive mindset.

highlights.title: Court Awareness
highlights.text: Understanding spacing, movement patterns, and reading the game at an introductory level.

ctaText: Reach out to learn more about our developmental program for young athletes.
